## 6. Tests and probes to write; tools, exporters, modules and harness files created (generated by `tests_tbl.py` and `t6.py`)

**Method.** A test file is *created* by an item whose `WHERE` line names it after `NEW` (`census.py`); an item that names an existing or earlier-created file adds to it. U3 §6.1's rows (test files a gate names that are not in the tree) are matched by file name against every item's text; U3 §6.2's probes (scripts a producing lane ran and did not commit) by name.

**Readings.** **271 test files are created**, each by one item, after this lane's edits: two collisions were found and decided by the landing order (ladder step 5: the earlier landing creates, the later adds): `test_sc_hearing_capabilities.py` (B04.18 creates at S6; B24.04's `NEW` removed) and `test_vm_mat_d_paper.py` (B26.07 creates at S17; B23.04, at S18, had assumed it went first: `NEW` removed); the third, `test_vres_task_and_prize.py` (B07.04, B11.83), is already conditional in B11.83's own text ("if B07 did not create it, else that file"). **`test_play_surface.py`**: one file, `engine/season/tests/test_play_surface.py`, created by B34 (part 25_cont, its `UNDECIDED` U6 citing `IS-B3` part 2 §6.1) and added to by B38's `IS-B3-GO-04` item; this is the resolution `master/instructions/IS_CHECK.md` C9 recorded (ladder step 4: the tree's other season tests sit there): **confirmed**. **U3 §6.1**: 24 of its rows parse in the form this script reads (U3 says 28; four rows are written differently and were not matched by name, an instrument limit); of the 24, 20 are named by an item and four are not, each opened (table a). **U3 §6.2**: 140 probe names over its rows; **59 are named by no item**. A probe need not be named: its reading must be restated as a named test or an existing instrument (U3 §6.2's own rule), which an item may do without the probe's name; the 59 are listed for the check lanes' copy-fidelity pass (`V12_STRUCTURE_part3.md` §10.1 item 7), not as defects: `a1_norms.py`, `an1.py`, `b1_season.py`, `bout_calc2.py`, `c1_two_men.py`, `calibrate.py`, `d1_cuts.py`, `d1_read.py`, `d_projection.py`, `hearsay_doer_probe.py`, `knock.py`, `knock2.py`, `levy_probe.py`, `n1_favour_two_ladders.py`, `p10_edges.py`, `p11_extremes.py`, `p12_proxy3.py`, `p13_same_cells.py`, `p15_shape.py`, `p15b_shape_proxy.py`, `p1_grid.py`, `p1_petitioner.py`, `p1_size.py`, `p2_flank.py`, `p2_lie.py`, `p2b_lie_extremes.py`, `p2c_two_readers.py`, `p2d_stale_sighting.py`, `p34.py`, `p3_hearing_ends.py`, `p4_verdict.py`, `p5_tired.py`, `p9_proxy.py`, `pB_yield.py`, `pM_yield_draw.py`, `pS2.py`, `pS_season.py`, `pes_play.py`, `pes_supply.py`, `pf5_heads.py`, `pf6_fixcheck.py`, `planted_grid.py`, `probe1.py`, `probe2.py`, `probe_foils.py`, `probe_r01_control.py`, `probe_reach.py`, `probe_reason.py`, `probe_round_state.py`, `probe_scar_stock.py`, `probe_vacuity.py`, `probe_voices.py`, `qreuse_small.py`, `realm_tap.py`, `refclaim.py`, `req_forge.py`, `se_ground.py`, `se_probe.py`, `x1_extremes.py`.

### 11.2 Gates that are a reading, not an execution artifact (lane H3, generated by `residue.py`, hand-classed; the bodies are not rewritten)

`residue.py` scans every item `GATE` and block `BATCH GATE` line for an arm that reads a `## Status:` line, counts lines or keywords of a document, or reads that a document "states (1) to (n)", and skips arms the repair lanes already relabelled as a record line or the critic's verdict. **27 arms in 26 items or blocks.** Listed below are the 15 whose gate has no other executed arm, or whose executed arm is itself a document count; the rest are not residue: B21c.06, B27.14, B27.15, B27.19, B27.22, B27.23, B10.53, B31.01, B38.51 and B10.51's second arm already pair the "states" reading with `test -f` or `ls` and a `git diff --stat` arm (R2c, R2d's form), the "states" half being the `ners` critic's (§5.8); and B03.66, B03.70 read `wc -l CLAUDE.md` against its cap, which is the rule's own instrument on a process surface (CLAUDE.md's preamble; §0.05 clause 4).

**The minimum execution artifact** for every DESIGN-FIRST row below is the one R2c and R2d wrote for B21c.06 and B27.14: `test -f <the item's design file>` → exit 0, and `git diff --stat <item-base>..HEAD -- engine modules tools` → empty (no code), with "states (1) to (n), each with a falsifier" moved to the `ners` critic's verdict in the commit body.
